days.title: Coastal Discoveries and Historic Ruins
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Naturum-Zentrum
stops.detail: The starting point for all paths is a Naturum center in the south of Trollskogen, where information about the landscapes of Öland is provided.

stops.name: Jaktmuren
stops.detail: Also noteworthy is the Jaktmuren (Hunting Wall) dating from the 16th century, which runs through the south.

stops.name: Steinstrände der Ostsee
stops.detail: Near the stone beaches of the Baltic Sea, the often strong wind causes the unusual growth of the trees standing in unprotected locations.

days.title: Ancient Oaks and Prehistoric Sites
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Grankullaviken
stops.detail: The beach facing the Grankullaviken bay is characterized by open coastal meadows serving as grazing land, unlike the Baltic Sea beaches.

stops.name: Trolleken
stops.detail: Located near the east coast is the particularly old and gnarled oak Trolleken (German: Magic Oak).

stops.name: Grabhügel und Steinsetzungen
stops.detail: In the area of the nature reserve, there are about 15 burial mounds and stone settings of prehistoric grave sites.
